description: This file defines an internal sealed partial class ActivationRebalancerWorker in the Orleans runtime, responsible for managing activation rebalancing across silos using entropy-based algorithms. It implements mechanisms for statistics collection, rebalancing cycles, and session management, including event handling, reporting, and silo migration logic.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: A runtime worker responsible for rebalancing grain activations across silos, managing entropy calculations, migration suggestions, and session control, to optimize cluster resource utilization.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes timers, subscribes to statistics change events, and prepares the worker upon activation.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes from statistics change events and performs cleanup during deactivation.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Serializes the current worker state for persistence.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Restores worker state from persisted data, resuming previous session settings.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Returns a report of current rebalancer status and statistics.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Restarts a rebalancing session and triggers an immediate report.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing activity for a specified duration.

methods.name: ReportAllMonitors
methods.description: Sends current report to all active silo monitors.

methods.name: BuildReport
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive status report of the rebalancer.

methods.name: TriggerRebalancing
methods.description: Initiates a rebalancing session if conditions permit.

methods.name: RunRebalancingCycle
methods.description: Performs a full rebalancing cycle, including entropy calculations, migration planning, and execution.

methods.name: UpdateStatistics
methods.description: Updates rebalancing statistics after a migration operation.

methods.name: ComputeEntropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy measure for the current distribution of activations.

methods.name: ComputeHarmonicMean
methods.description: Computes the harmonic mean of activations' counts across silos.

methods.name: ComputeAllowedEntropyDeviation
methods.description: Determines dynamic allowed deviation in entropy based on total activations.

methods.name: ComputeAdaptiveScaling
methods.description: Calculates an adaptive scaling factor for migration aggressiveness based on cycle count and silo number.

methods.name: FormSiloPairs
methods.description: Creates pairs of silos for potential migration based on current activation counts.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.description: Begins a rebalancing session, setting timers and resetting counters.

methods.name: StopSession
methods.description: Ends a rebalancing session, recording reasons and managing timers.

methods.name: SuspendFor
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing activity for a specified duration.
